t: You're at Charing Cross tube station, in the City of Westminster. It's served by the Bakerloo and Northern lines, and it connects to the mainline station above. On the Bakerloo line it sits between Piccadilly Circus and Embankment. The Jubilee line also stopped here, from 1979 to 1999. It's in fare zone 1. The Scottish trade unionist and politician Thomas McKerrell died here.
